question: Is the with-trend double-bottom/top + divergence idea profitable on some timeframe and parameter neighbourhood, better than random entries, and which confluence features (if any) carry information?
known_before_freeze: H3B 1h (w=3, e=0.5, d=2, 2R/72h) base results and S117 (entries ~ random; long no-target holds looked better in-sample) were seen. H1 trend pullback v1/v2 and H3 v1 were rejected by another session.

detector.logic: H3B logic (pivot pair, equal extremes, RSI divergence, neckline height >= 1 ATR, first close beyond neckline within 24 pattern bars, latest confirmed pivot only, with-trend on the higher TF via EMA20/EMA50 of its last 300 closed bars)
detector.indicators: RSI14 (Wilder) and ATR14 computed causally on the full history up to each bar
detector.fixed: separation 5-60 bars, height >= 1 ATR, break within 24 bars, stop buffer 0.25 ATR beyond the farther extreme

execution.entry: market at the first 1m close at/after bar close + 3 min; no trade if that close is already beyond the stop

exits.E2: no target, max hold 168 pattern bars

execution.fills: resolver conventions: same-bar stop first, target maker no slippage, stop/time taker with slippage, hold = minutes - 1 bars
execution.costs: taker 5 bps, maker 2 bps, slippage 10 bps (stress) for all selection and gates

steps_1_2_selection.walk_forward: fold 1: best stress mean net R on 2024 -> evaluate 2025; fold 2: best on 2024-2025 -> evaluate 2026; selection over all 162 configs (a config needs >= 30 train trades)
steps_1_2_selection.plateau: share of the chosen config's 26 entry-grid neighbours (same TF, same exit) with positive train mean
steps_1_2_selection.random_control: for each OOS trade, 20 random entries (same symbol, year, direction, risk_pct, exit); difference with day-block bootstrap 95% CI
steps_1_2_selection.pass: OOS stress mean > 0 with 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND random-control difference CI lower bound > 0 AND plateau share >= 0.5 in both folds

step_3_confluence.trade_set: the walk-forward fold-2 chosen config if steps 1-2 pass; otherwise the H3B-like reference config (1h, w=3, e=0.5, d=2, E2) as a diagnostic
features_at_entry: break_volume_ratio (break bar volume / median of prior 20)
btc_alignment (BTC 4h trend agrees, for non-BTC symbols)
funding_at_entry (last settled, sign-adjusted so positive = paid to us)
step_3_confluence.method: development = 2024-2025 trades: Spearman correlation of each feature with net R, 10,000-permutation p-values, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 10%. Each surviving feature becomes a filter 'keep the favourable two terciles' (tercile cut points from development), evaluated on 2026 vs unfiltered with day-block bootstrap.
step_3_confluence.reading: features that fail FDR are reported as uninformative and must not be used as discretionary confluence

decision_meaning: PASS authorizes a new frozen plugin protocol evaluated forward (shadow/paper) only
no_further_search: any change requires a new protocol id
